subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should fresh authorized MCP Apps be allowed to request one exact plain-text user message through the normal chat-send path under the proposed confirmation, focus, visibility, slash-command, size, and rate-limit safeguards?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded and fail-closed, but enabling agent-authored app content to request a user message is an intentional trust-policy expansion that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the bounded bridge
options.body: Accept the documented safeguards and allow exact-head required checks to gate the complete messaging and host-context implementation.

options.title: Defer app messaging
options.body: Remove the message.text advertisement and handler while retaining the read-only reconstruction and live host-context improvements.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded bridge
recommendation.body: Accept the documented safeguards and allow exact-head required checks to gate the complete messaging and host-context implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision combines Control UI consent UX with Agent DevX behavior and should be made independently of the PR author.
